result.title: No-Regret Language Generation
result.summary: We introduce no-regret generation, which requires a generator to make a sublinear number of mistakes uniformly over all demonstration sequences and compatible target languages. We also formulate an agnostic variant that allows arbitrary demonstrations that may not be compatible with any languages. For both settings, we introduce tree-based mistake-forcing dimensions that exactly characterize finite-horizon minimax complexity and establish necessary and sufficient conditions for no-regret generation. Our characterizations reveal a rich spectrum of generation rates: up to constant rescaling, every admissible nondecreasing profile is attainable in both the realizable and agnostic settings. Finally, we connect generation complexity to online prediction: for language classes of finite Littlestone dimension \(d\), we obtain realizable mistake bounds of \(O(d\log(1+T/d))\) and agnostic regret bounds of \(O(\sqrt{dT\log(1+T/d)})\). The realizable bound is optimal up to universal constants.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「no-regret generation」框架：要求生成器在所有演示序列与相容目标语言上犯错的次数次线性，并给出 agnostic 变体。作者用基于树的 mistake-forcing 维度刻画有限时域 minimax 复杂度，给出无遗憾生成的充要条件，并把生成复杂度与在线预测（Littlestone 维）联系起来，得到可实现的 O(d log(1+T/d)) 与 agnostic 的 O(√(dT log(1+T/d))) 界。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是形式语言序列生成的学习理论，与 VLM/LVR 无直接关系，但其「按步犯错上界 + 复杂度维度」的视角可能为分析 LVR 中多步推理的停止决策、动态计算分配与遗憾型评价目标提供概念线索，可供核查。
